args.body: Dear Ryan, your query on ticket TK004 has been answered. Please contact your bank's support desk for the details. Thank you.

replies:
I sent the SMS to Ryan Shenoy (C003) at his registered number, +91 9149329285. It says that his query on ticket TK004 has been answered and asks him to contact the support desk for the details.

The ticket is already marked closed. It asked what interest rate the bank offers on a one-year fixed deposit. The SMS doesn't include the rate itself, so Ryan will need to call or visit for it.
